name: CTS Co.,Ltd.
summary: CTS Co., Ltd. mainly provides ICT construction services for the construction industry in Japan. It also offers cloud storage, network camera rental and cloud video with recording, builds outdoor networks, supplies mobaden, a mobile fixed-IP phone service for site offices, and supports remote work through the GENBA Connect communication tool. It further designs and builds emergency shelters, solar lighting and playground equipment. Dating from 1972, it has its headquarters in Ueda, Japan.
